name: stm32g071
description: ST STM32G071xB (Cortex-M0+ 64 MHz, 128 KB flash, 36 KB SRAM, USART1-4, LPUART1, SPI1-2, I2C1-2, TIM1/2/3/6/7/14/15/16/17, LPTIM1-2, ADC, 2-channel DAC, DMAMUX): GNU Arm toolchain with the STM32CubeG0 HAL/LL, Renode stm32g071 platform

toolchain.notes: Link with a STM32G071RBTx_FLASH.ld and startup_stm32g071xx.s from a Cube example (Projects/NUCLEO-G071RB/Templates). Whole Cube examples build with tools/stm32cube/build_example.py in the Renode tree; CubeIDE board projects build with `embeddyn mechatronics import`.

image.notes: load the ELF; the vector table is at 0x08000000

renode.notes: Boards: platforms/boards/st/nucleo_g071rb.repl (LD4 PA5 = led4, B1 PC13 = sysbus.gpioPortC.userButton, active low, VCP usart2). The RCC clock tree (HSI16/HSIDIV, HSE, PLL R output, HPRE, PPRE) drives SysTick and the timers. Peripheral DMA requests go to DMAMUX inputs numbered by request ID (e.g. USART2_TX = 53) and reach the DMA1 channel whose DMAMUX_CxCR selects them. EXTI lines take the port EXTI_EXTICR selects. ADC: 'adc SetVoltage microvolts channel'. DAC: 'dac OutputVoltage 0'. RTC (RTCv3) and TAMP share the RTC_TAMP vector. Not modelled: UCPD, COMP, CEC. Pins: add 'pins: Miscellaneous.PinRecorder @ gpioPortA 0' and connections such as 'gpioPortA:' / '    5 -> led2@0 | pins@5' (a .repl file), then 'sysbus.gpioPortA.pins Edges 5'. Docs: tools/stm32cube/README.md.

reference.simulator: none; the models are checked with the STM32CubeG0 examples (tools/stm32cube/run_examples.py with examples_g071.txt in the Renode tree)
